clusters.name: Run the decision lenses
clusters.jtbd_family: Take a sharpened question plus prep context and run it through adversarial, risk, bayesian, immune and synthesis lenses to produce a graded position with a Y state.
clusters.serves_geometry: Every receipt. Measured corpus is PLAN 161 and COURT 96, FORK 137 and PARADOX 116 (253 of 267), TWO_WAY 171 and ONE_WAY 96, stakes MEDIUM 156 and HIGH 74. GREEN 0, LOCKED 0, SHARP 0: the lenses have never produced a sharp verdict in prod. The Python suite is not wired to the compass route (AGENTS.md integration status); the TS L0 to L5 prompt in src/app/api/compass/route.ts is what runs.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap here when a question exists and no verdict exists yet, or when a verdict exists and someone wants a second named lens on the same D (BAR for ruin, LAB for adversarial, Court for a one-way door). Lowest energy because every other cluster consumes a receipt; this one is the only one that makes a verdict.

clusters.name: Invoke, persist and trace an engine run
clusters.jtbd_family: Make an engine run callable, persisted and traceable: an HTTP or MCP entry point, an append-only store, a trace span, and serializable parallel futures.
clusters.serves_geometry: Session depth 2 and up (26 sessions at depth 2 to 3, 15 at depth 4 plus, max 13): persistence, replay and future serialization only matter once a session holds more than one receipt. Prod persistence is Prisma in the compass route, not this cluster.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap here when the job is call the engine from somewhere else or keep what the engine said, not decide. Yoav serialization when two branches could commit the same future.

clusters.name: Find the cross-domain echo
clusters.jtbd_family: Surface a kinematic isomorphism from another domain that reframes the stuck question, then falsify it before trusting it (tributary [2] adjacent; ROM primitive 5).
clusters.serves_geometry: PARADOX 116 and flowTopology DIVERGENT 154: a reframe is the move when the Y state is entangled or the paths diverge. Pulls on depth 2 plus sessions where the same D keeps returning.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap when the question has been run and the answer is both or neither, and the user needs a different frame rather than more evidence. The dogfood and ridgeline dither harnesses stay in the cluster so an echo is tested, not decreed.

clusters.name: Encode a signal for the recipient's altitude and cognitive state
clusters.jtbd_family: Translate a decision or signal to the altitude and register a specific recipient can receive without loss, gated by whether that recipient is cognitively safe to receive it right now.
clusters.serves_geometry: The handoff of a verdict to a counterpart. Altitude free text in the corpus spans L0 to L4. Pulls on COURT and ONE_WAY sends where a mis-pitched message is itself irreversible.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap when the decision is made and the remaining risk is in the transmission, not the content. All three are UNAUDITED and not wired to a route; today the register tuning actually happens in forge and counterpart-gauntlet.

clusters.name: Attest and record a decision as it happens
clusters.jtbd_family: Freeze the position at the moment it is taken: the DEWY stub, the witness stub, the assumptions ledger, the receipt contract and its timing fields.
clusters.serves_geometry: Every receipt at write time. Horizon WEEK 175 dominates, so the reviewDate written here is mostly ~1 week out. Status OPEN 264 of 267: almost every attestation is still waiting for a close.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap when something just happened (a decision, a flash, a premise accepted) and it must be stamped before it is reconstructed. Lowest energy because attesting later costs a false timestamp (WORLD.md Witness).

clusters.name: Close the loop: outcomes, calibration, belief change
clusters.jtbd_family: Compare what was predicted with what happened, move the belief that was wrong, score calibration per cohort, and propagate the lesson to everything built on the old belief.
clusters.serves_geometry: Outcomes 3 of 267, matched 2, avg regretScore 2.33, status LOGGED 3, driftState LANDED 2. Pulls on receipts whose horizon has passed; with WEEK 175 that is most of the corpus. The Accountant refuses to calibrate below n=30 per cohort, so this is 14 tools serving a geometry with n=3.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap when a reviewDate has passed or a counterpart has responded. The energy well is real but almost nothing rolls into it: the capture rate, not the tooling, is the gap.

clusters.name: Prepare for, run and close a counterpart encounter
clusters.jtbd_family: Before a call, assemble the context and the ex-ante receipt; after it, pull the transcript, score the receipt against reality, and render the war room.
clusters.serves_geometry: Mode COURT, door ONE_WAY, stakes HIGH when a human counterpart is on the other side (ONE_WAY 96; COURT is also 96, likely the same rows, not confirmed). Horizon TODAY 22 and WEEK 175: a meeting is on the calendar. Kairos URGENT or CLOSING.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap when a named person and a timestamp exist. T-minus, T-zero, T-plus is the lowest-energy ordering because the transcript is the only outcome signal the corpus reliably captures while prod outcomes stay at 3.

clusters.name: Forge and harden a counterpart-facing artifact family
clusters.jtbd_family: Build the clean surface family a counterpart will read, then run it through the pre-send gauntlet under a cost budget until it is send-worthy.
clusters.serves_geometry: ONE_WAY door (a sent artifact cannot be unsent), stakes HIGH, mode COURT, kairos CLOSING (a send date). Depth 4 plus: forge runs are the multi-day sessions (12 measured).
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap when an artifact exists that someone outside the air-gap will see and a send date exists. Falls to the public-surface gate cluster when there is no named counterpart.

clusters.name: Scan personal data for observed motion
clusters.jtbd_family: Extract revealed preference from calendar, listening, reading, network and forensic data so prep is grounded in what the person actually did, not what they say.
clusters.serves_geometry: Upstream of a receipt; serves the PrepSession, not the Y state. Pulls on horizon QUARTER 51 and YEARS 19 (pattern over time) more than TODAY 22. The 118 depth-1 sessions with no prep are where this would matter and where it is not used.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap when the question is vague and the person's own data is at hand; a scanner envelope is the cheapest D sharpener (stdlib only, no LLM).

clusters.name: Run the job-search pipeline
clusters.jtbd_family: Source winnable reqs, verify they are real, screen the counterparty for malice, cut and gate the resume and public posts.
clusters.serves_geometry: TWO_WAY door (an application is reversible) at MEDIUM stakes, horizon WEEK, mode PLAN. The one domain with a real outcome ledger (second_pass_ledger rejections), so calibration can be tested here first.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap when the counterpart is an employer or recruiter. Three-gate smoke test before the call, never after.

clusters.name: Author and render a public page or post
clusters.jtbd_family: Turn a markdown source or data JSON into a styled page in the arcs.care family with frozen publish timestamps, series denotation, brand tokens and a local preview.
clusters.serves_geometry: TWO_WAY (a page can be unpublished) at LOW to MEDIUM stakes, PLAN mode, horizon WEEK. Not a receipt geometry; the pull is the press schedule and the fate registry (ADR-068 print schedule).
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap when a source exists and the destination is a public URL with no named reader. The gate cluster runs before this one ships.

clusters.name: Gate a public surface before anyone sees it
clusters.jtbd_family: Mechanically fail a page that would wrap wrong, leak an internal fact, cite nothing, read as slop or re-author tokens, before a human looks at it.
clusters.serves_geometry: ONE_WAY in practice (a leaked internal fact is irreversible once crawled) even when the page is TWO_WAY; stakes rise to HIGH on prospect-facing pages. Frustration-gate pattern: fail the class, not the instance.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap whenever a file under public/ or an artifact directory changes. Lowest energy because the gate is cheaper than the eyeball and the eyeball misses the narrow-lede class.

clusters.name: Project a safe public mirror of an internal ledger
clusters.jtbd_family: Change basis from an internal append-only ledger to a public file that carries only whitelisted keys, so the shape crosses the air-gap and the names do not.
clusters.serves_geometry: ONE_WAY (what is served is crawled), stakes HIGH, mode COURT. Serves the believability and gauntlet ledgers and the status floor.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap when an internal instrument should be visible to prospects. The four-thing contract (source, whitelist, template, check) beats a hand-written page because --check makes drift mechanical.

clusters.name: Replay the trajectory (observatory data path)
clusters.jtbd_family: Build the Observatory payload (events, risks, layers) from a repo's commit and release history under an editable rule set, redacting open risks.
clusters.serves_geometry: Session depth 2 plus (41 of 159 sessions) is the geometry WORLD.md promises the Observatory serves. Measured: all three tools ingest git and GitHub, not Receipt rows, so they replay the build, not the decisions.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap when the question is how did we get here over a repo. Does not snap for a receipt session today.

clusters.name: Digest a corpus into a graded reading room
clusters.jtbd_family: Grade, cache and render a corpus (essays, engagement artifacts, concepts) as an almanac, chronicle and concordance, re-grading only slices whose sources changed.
clusters.serves_geometry: Horizon QUARTER and YEARS (a corpus accrues), depth 4 plus sessions, PLAN mode. Cost-governed by the cache manifest.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap when the same corpus is read more than once; the manifest makes the second read nearly free.

clusters.name: Bank vocabulary, lore, proverbs and canon; propagate changes
clusters.jtbd_family: Keep the four books (dictionary, encyclopedia, thesaurus, proverbs) and the seed bank consistent, mint proverbs from decisions, and propagate a change in a first-order source to everything downstream.
clusters.serves_geometry: Not per-receipt; pulls on horizon YEARS and on every ADR or ROM candidate landing. Kairos OPEN (canon never closes).
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap when a word, a story or a law changed and other files cite it. The nightly sentinel makes the propagation check the lowest-energy default.

clusters.name: Route a job to the one right tool; inventory the toolset
clusters.jtbd_family: Given a stated job, name the one existing tool (ADR-070 induction surface), keep the catalog and operator registry generated from source, and forge a new tool only when none fits.
clusters.serves_geometry: Every session start; the 256-tool catalog is the input to this very map. QUICKMOVE in spirit (10 measured): the route should be one call.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap before any new script is written (memory jtbd-reuse-existing-tool-before-inventing).

clusters.name: Hand off and pick up a session losslessly
clusters.jtbd_family: Fold a dense session's residue into cold-moltable chips and one arc block at close; unfold and orient at open without re-reading everything.
clusters.serves_geometry: Session depth 2 plus and the 12 multi-day sessions; median span 56 minutes at depth 2 plus. Kairos CLOSING (context about to compact).
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap at compaction or session end; the hook fires it. Lowest energy because the alternative, re-deriving next session, cost ~40k tokens per session before 2026-07-19.

clusters.name: Keep the open-loop backlog honest
clusters.jtbd_family: One read over every open-loop store: waiting on a yes, closable in 15 minutes, rotting, ripe, captured today; let demand signals move priority.
clusters.serves_geometry: Status OPEN 264 of 267 receipts plus the induced backlog: the corpus is almost entirely open loops. This cluster detects kairos transitions (OPEN to CLOSING) for backlog rows, not for receipts.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap at the start of the day or when choosing what to do next. Read-only, no new store.

clusters.name: Serialize parallel sessions and worktrees
clusters.jtbd_family: Give concurrent sessions one sequence authority (numbers, time), one write lock on hot files, and safe worktree sync and reclamation so parallel work does not collide.
clusters.serves_geometry: Not per-receipt; pulls whenever more than one session is live (cap 4 per memory). ONE_WAY: a doubled ADR number or a clobbered file is a one-way door.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap before minting any number or writing a shared anchor. Git's non-fast-forward rejection is the atomic gate; everything here rides it.

clusters.name: Ship code to main under the repo contract
clusters.jtbd_family: Score the diff, enforce the constitutional code rules (inline styles, model registry, RLS, null userId, purpose), merge with a merge commit, detect squashes.
clusters.serves_geometry: TWO_WAY door with a cheap revert, MEDIUM stakes, PLAN mode; NCI thresholds >=50 and >=45. merge_train exists because CI runs are the cost driver.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap on every commit via pre-commit; lowest energy because session-start arms the hooks.

clusters.name: Deploy and verify production
clusters.jtbd_family: Apply prod migrations, deploy through the guardrail wrapper, refuse branch-pinned domains, run the acceptance smoke.
clusters.serves_geometry: ONE_WAY door (a migration), stakes HIGH, mode COURT, kairos URGENT when prod is broken.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap when the change touches schema or the serving project. Never bare vercel --prod.

clusters.name: Audit the system for drift between claim and state
clusters.jtbd_family: Compare what docs, handoffs and backlog claim against live git, deploy and DB state; root-cause one error when it is worth it; reconstruct a post-mortem cold.
clusters.serves_geometry: driftState ON_TRACK 261 and DRIFTING 4 is the receipt-side signal; this cluster works the repo side. Scheduled (04:00 UTC sentinel, nightly risk sweep) plus on demand.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap when something feels off or a handoff lands. Read-only.

clusters.name: Govern cost and blast radius
clusters.jtbd_family: Measure the per-turn token floor, bound every long-running task with a timeout, route by battery, batch API calls.
clusters.serves_geometry: Orthogonal to receipts; pulls on every fan-out and every long job.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap before any fan-out or long task (token-savings-bank rule). watchdog is the default stop rule, not an afterthought.

clusters.name: Preserve work off-machine
clusters.jtbd_family: Encrypted snapshot to iCloud and a mirror of built bundles.
clusters.serves_geometry: Not a decision geometry; a durability job.
clusters.magnetic_rule: Snap on a schedule, not on a decision.
